Namespace ShapeEngine.Geometry.CollisionSystem

Classes

BroadphaseBucket

Represents a collection of colliders within a single spatial hash bucket.

BroadphaseColliderRegister<T>

Manages a register of colliders and their associated data for broadphase collision detection.

BroadphaseDynamicSpatialHash

Implements a dynamic spatial hash broadphase for collision detection. Efficiently manages colliders in spatial buckets for fast broadphase queries. Only creates and stores buckets that contain colliders, optimizing memory usage. Old buckets that become empty are recycled for future use. Does not maintain persistent bounds; bounds are recalculated each frame based on added colliders.

BroadphaseSpatialHash

Implements a spatial hash grid for efficient broad-phase collision detection and spatial queries.

BroadphaseStaticColliderRegister<T>

Manages registration and tracking of static colliders and their associated data for broadphase collision detection.

CastSpaceEntry

Represents a collection of colliders associated with a specific collision object, used for cast space queries.

CastSpaceResult

Represents the result of a cast space query, mapping collision objects to their associated colliders.

Collider

Abstract base class for all colliders in the collision system.

Collision

Contains the information of an intersection or an overlap between two colliders.

CollisionInformation

Contains the information of a collision between two collision objects in the form of a list of collisions. Each collision is an intersection or overlap between two colliders.

CollisionObject

Represents an object that participates in the collision system and can contain multiple colliders. Handles collision detection, intersection, and overlap logic, and provides events and hooks for collision notifications.

IntersectSpaceEntry

Represents an entry in the intersection space, containing collision points and information about the other collider involved in the intersection.

IntersectSpaceRegister

Represents a register of intersection entries for a specific CollisionObject.

IntersectSpaceResult

Represents the result of an intersection space query, containing registers of intersection entries for multiple collision objects.

IntersectionPoints

Represents a list of IntersectionPoints, providing validation, filtering, and sorting utilities for collision detection.

Overlap

Represents an overlap between two colliders.

Interfaces

IBroadphase

Represents a broadphase collision detection system interface. Inherits from IBounds. Provides methods for managing collision objects and retrieving candidate buckets for collision checks. CollisionHandler is using this interface to perform broadphase collision detection.

Specifies the broadphase collision detection strategy for a collider. FullShape is the default.
